title: The Effects of an Evening Snack of Walnuts on Diet and Sleep Quality in Adolescents
official: The Effects of an Evening Snack of Walnuts on Diet and Sleep Quality in Adolescents
summary: The goal of this study is to examine whether an evening snack of 1 oz of walnuts consumed in place of usual evening snacks for 4 weeks has a beneficial effect on diet quality and sleep quality in adolescents age 13-17 years.
criteria:
Adolescent Inclusion Criteria:

* Age 13 to 17 years
* Enrolled in school (secondary education) that has defined start and end times (i.e., traditional in-person school or home/virtual school with a consistent schedule)
* Consumes snacks in the evening (between dinner and sleep) on most nights
* Able to read and answer questions in English

Adolescent Exclusion Criteria:

* Sleep disorder (e.g., insomnia, sleep disordered breathing, narcolepsy)
* Developmental disorder (e.g., autism, intellectual disability, developmental delay)
* Diabetes
* Any other medical condition impacting sleep or diet
* Taking supplements or medications that affect sleep or eating behavior, including melatonin supplements
* Current allergy or history of allergy to tree nuts or peanuts (any severity)
* Other current severe food allergies
* Unwilling to consume walnuts daily
* Already consumes tree nuts 1 or more times per week
* Parent/guardian not willing to participate

Parent Inclusion Criteria

* Parent/guardian of a participating adolescent
* Age 18 years or older
* Able to read and answer questions in English

There are no additional exclusion criteria for parents
